supersession_reason: The initial attempt stopped during baseline arithmetic-parity checks (5/20 imports failed); no additional accuracy, pair or timing jobs ran. Keep all grids, seeds, estimator settings and strict parity tolerances unchanged. Fix only rollout arithmetic.
rollout_policy: Compute the global Lipschitz bound L of the fitted piecewise-quadratic odd force from its coefficients and knots. If 2*max(dt)*L >= 1, use the original pairwise Euler implementation from the first step; otherwise use exact prefix-moment drift evaluation. This is a conservative arithmetic safeguard, not a stability theorem or a change to the estimator, Euler step, coefficients, or error metric.
baseline_policy: Keep N=1000, T=2, dt=0.005, sigma=0.1, sigma_obs=0 except the plotted parameter; preserve truth, tests, initial law, solver and validation rule.
grid_provenance: Original Figure 2 grids, adding N=1000 as the common baseline. Runtime also includes N=1000.
pair_penalty_policy: Use the full-pair training/validation-selected absolute alpha and the same descending absolute-alpha warm-start path from zero through its selected index. Never reselect alpha using P, truth or test data.
pair_nonconvergence_policy: Retain every finite solver output, including nonconverged fixed-alpha endpoints, in explicitly labeled finite-iteration diagnostics; mark incomplete convergence and record all warnings. Missing/nonfinite outputs invalidate the all-run mean. Also report converged endpoint counts; do not silently average only successes.
data_policy: Reuse the 20 declared triplets and baseline results. Same data within each dictionary comparison. Observation-noise levels share X and standardized noise. Across N or dt the same seed does not imply nested particles or coupled Brownian paths. dt is both the Euler-Maruyama integration and observation step.
evaluation_policy: Independent true test trajectories, all times/all off-diagonal pairs, trapezoidal force/drift weights. Each physical setting has its own test measure; observation-noise and P sweeps share the baseline test measure. Freeze all dictionary coefficients before evaluation.
assembly_policy: Exact 1D hat full-pair sums via prefix moments; sampled off-diagonal ordered pairs with replacement, redrawn at each contributing time. No standardization; 200 weak rows scaled by 1/sqrt(200).
timing_policy: Sequential, one numerical thread, after estimation jobs finish; time complete assembly separately per dictionary including geometry and pair draws. Exclude simulation, response, fitting, diagnostics and file IO. Randomize dictionary/mode order before each timing repetition. Report medians and IQR; not a general-dimensional quadratic-cost benchmark.
failure_policy: Run all planned cases without seed selection or outcome-based stopping. Retain failed cases, unconverged candidates, boundary selections, rollouts leaving the basis interval and numerical divergence. Do not refit, smooth, or threshold coefficients.
plot_policy: Consistent dictionary colors/markers for M=9,17,33,65; 4:3 axes; arithmetic means with pointwise paired-bootstrap 95% intervals for errors. No theoretical rate lines. Six-panel force/trajectory/drift views plus pair-approximation diagnostics.
